interface.shortDescription: Evidence Lane 2.0.0 · 62 native actions (21 read / 41 write) · 15 governed skills.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane is human-governed project memory that preserves exact source, evidence, Delta, task, candidate, and accepted-version identity across AI work. Evidence Lane 2.0.0 is the stable Codex release identity; product identity stays Evidence Lane. This exact Codex 2.0.0 package carries fifteen governed skills and one package-local native MCP server named evidence-lane with sixty-two canonical actions: twenty-one read-only and forty-one write-capable. It can run Source Intake, Build, Refresh, pointer-only Rollback, exact-APPROVE Fuse, State Travel law, Mode, storage, plugin administration, panels, search, diff, and deployment evidence while keeping candidate acceptance human-controlled. Historical 1.5.0 Git, package, tunnel, and PV receipts remain immutable archive evidence. Normal ChatGPT connects separately to its registered remote MCP and is not silently upgraded by this Codex package. Google Drive is a separately named and authorized connector, never the Evidence Lane MCP, lifecycle proof, namespace owner, or durable local project authority. Codex lifecycle evidence must come from the package-local native server, never codex_apps, plugin-runtime, generated namespaces, direct-stdio fallback, or the remote tunnel. Natural HIL intent never promotes a candidate, and only exact case-sensitive APPROVE may authorize Fuse on a genuinely write-capable governed host.
